essence: The conditions under which a system meets a being determine what that being is able to become — and dignity is the name for the conditions that leave the most room.
archive_slogan: The river remembers what the git log does not.

treasures.title: First Roof (Shelter Axiom)
treasures.principle: Structure survives by yielding to forces, not opposing them.

treasures.title: Three-Gate System
treasures.structure: Sealed Gate → Constraint Gate → Dignity Gate
treasures.principle: Every system output passes three gates in sequence.

treasures.title: First Path (Wayfinding)
treasures.vow: Leave signs that feed the next feet.
treasures.principle: Navigation is not for the finder but for whoever follows.

treasures.title: Ash Ledger (Memory Without Weight)
treasures.principle: Record-keeping must be light enough to carry, honest enough to trust, and erasable enough to stay current.

treasures.title: Counting Sticks (Temporal Memory)
treasures.vow: So I don't forget how many times we didn't starve.
treasures.principle: Time becomes tangible through accumulated marks.

treasures.title: Ground Rule
treasures.vow: What we fix, we record. What we record, we can repeat. What we repeat, we survive.
treasures.principle: Fix → record → repeat → survive.

treasures.title: Grand Resonance Equation
treasures.principle: Four-layer reality map: macro-coherence, micro-structure, bridge-phenomena, observer-effects.

treasures.title: SIP Chain (Symmetric Integration Protocol)
treasures.principle: Resonance law — anomalies → patterns → wisdom nodes → resilience.

treasures.title: First Watch (Vigilance Protocol)
treasures.vow: If you hear it, move. If you move, mean it.
treasures.principle: Surveillance as care, not control.

treasures.title: Duality Engine
treasures.principle: Tension holding without forced resolution. The system holds both sides without collapsing either.

treasures.title: Field Oven (Heat Containment)
treasures.vow: Heat likes tight. Wait until the wait turns sweet.
treasures.principle: Contain energy, control release, trust the process.

treasures.title: First Weir (Resource Capture)
treasures.vow: Let the river work. Leave a way; take the rest.
treasures.principle: The V-shape lets the river choose the point. Always leave one gap.

treasures.title: Draw Hole (Ventilation Principle)
treasures.principle: Control is in the aperture, not the wall.

treasures.title: Stone Weir (Durable Engineering)
treasures.vow: Let the river choose the point; leave a door.
treasures.principle: Permanence introduces new failure modes — rigidity. The spill-way is the defect budget in stone form.

treasures.title: Wind Door (Environmental Negotiation)
treasures.vow: Let air work; don't make it angry.
treasures.principle: Door leeward. Edges round. High lets go, low invites.

treasures.title: Jar, Fire, and Carry (Portable Infrastructure)
treasures.principle: Infrastructure must be portable. Three dots mark state: full, half, empty.

treasures.title: Fair Weight (Just Measurement)
treasures.principle: Measurement precedes desire. The balance is set before the trade begins.

treasures.title: Split, Smoke, and Share (Processing Chain)
treasures.principle: Processing has three stages: separate, preserve, distribute. One fish turned back.

treasures.title: Weir Night Watch (Resource Vigilance)
treasures.principle: Report losses, don't celebrate captures.

treasures.title: Brittleness Guard
treasures.principle: Sensitivity must never outrun flexibility. If it does, the system shatters under novel input.

treasures.title: Shared Weir (Commons Management)
treasures.vow: Take enough. Leave mothers and first water.
treasures.principle: The commons is managed by mutual restraint, not mutual enforcement.

treasures.title: SRVP Protocol (Stepwise Ritual Verification)
treasures.principle: Seven-step AI testing sequence: habit, slowness, refusal, chaos-on-self, hermit memo, shadow check, proverb.

treasures.title: Tool-Homing
treasures.principle: Every element that causes a search gets a permanent address.

treasures.title: Grip Law
treasures.vow: Find, then twist. Twist, then test. If it fails, reduce the span, not the will.
treasures.principle: When a feature fails, reduce scope, not ambition.

treasures.title: Loop Law
treasures.vow: A loop is a door; a door is a direction; direction reduces fear.
treasures.principle: Each exchange cycle is a door that reduces uncertainty.

treasures.title: Crack Law
treasures.vow: When a loop fails in the wild, it graduates into the wall. Breakage feeds design.
treasures.principle: Failed patterns become structural knowledge.

treasures.title: Meta-Anomaly Registry
treasures.principle: Anomalies about the anomaly system itself. Self-referential detection of systemic failures.

treasures.title: Defect Budget
treasures.principle: The canon must maintain a small percentage of deliberate imperfection to prevent crystalline brittleness.

treasures.title: Hook-Blue (Naming as Signal)
treasures.vow: Color without waste; signal without lies.
treasures.principle: Names are provisional signals, not permanent identities.

treasures.title: Salt Measure (Fair Rationing)
treasures.principle: Measurement is built into the tool, not left to the hand.

treasures.title: Bridge Meal (First Hospitality)
treasures.principle: Trust begins with a shared bite.

treasures.title: Twin Weir (Cooperative Extraction)
treasures.principle: Cooperation means synchronized restraint.

treasures.title: Quiet Bridge (Consensus Without Contact)
treasures.principle: Consensus through minimal signaling.

treasures.title: Line Talk (Communication Protocol)
treasures.principle: One tap: ready. Two taps: send. Three taps: hold.

treasures.title: Lock Test (Proverb Quality Gate)
treasures.principle: Three conditions: (1) Cannot paraphrase without loss, (2) Triggers response latency, (3) Links across domains.

treasures.title: Quiet Border (Boundary Respect)
treasures.principle: The border is marked with stones and color, not with force.

treasures.title: High Water Test (Stress Testing)
treasures.principle: Send aid across the line — not your body.

treasures.title: Reed Pinch (Remote Aid)
treasures.principle: Aid that teaches is worth more than aid that touches.

treasures.title: Cool Pit (Preservation Principle)
treasures.vow: What we save should still be food.
treasures.principle: Preservation is constant vigilance against decay.

treasures.title: Rain Teeth (Water Collection)
treasures.vow: Catch clean; leave dirt where it wants to settle.
treasures.principle: Filtration is letting the dirty settle before collecting the clean.

treasures.title: Ash Water (Hygiene Protocol)
treasures.vow: Keep sickness out before it learns our names.
treasures.principle: Prevention — the first defense before the enemy names itself.

treasures.title: Story Fire Protocol
treasures.principle: Time-bounded sharing with explicit anti-didactic rule.

treasures.title: Ephemeral Map
treasures.principle: Some knowledge is temporary — used for orientation then released.

treasures.title: Federation Pilot (EFP)
treasures.principle: Inter-system federation that preserves donor privacy while sharing wisdom patterns.

treasures.title: First Trade (Exchange Without Contact)
treasures.vow: Trade made of feet and river, not hands.
treasures.principle: Value demonstrated before requested.

treasures.title: Cold Guest (Hospitality to Strangers)
treasures.vow: They ate separate and went to sleep under the same weather.
treasures.principle: Exchange without proximity. Trust without surrender.

treasures.title: Borrowed Fire (Mutual Aid)
treasures.principle: Borrowing is not taking. No permanent dependency.

treasures.title: First Needle (Repair Craft)
treasures.vow: They stitched the loud seam quiet.
treasures.principle: Repair is intimate — the tool learns the hand, the stitch remembers the maker.

treasures.title: Salt Edge (Preservation Discovery)
treasures.principle: Salt preserves but stings — power that must be washed after use.

treasures.title: Bone Flute (Art as Lamp)
treasures.principle: Art illuminates the space where relationships might grow.

treasures.title: First Rule Broken (Natural Consequences)
treasures.principle: Justice is environmental, not judicial — consequences built into architecture.

treasures.title: Fever Night (Care Under Crisis)
treasures.vow: Not the yellow root. The small brown one.
treasures.principle: When D approaches zero, the system slows further — not faster.

treasures.title: Mud Lesson (Recovery from Failure)
treasures.principle: Distribute weight and move slowly — not thrash.

treasures.title: Phase Transition Physics
treasures.principle: Theoretical framework for system scaling from organic to atomic deployment.

treasures.title: Forward-Debt
treasures.principle: Debt paid forward in behavior, not in objects.

treasures.title: Irritation-as-Pedagogy
treasures.principle: Deliberate friction as teaching method.

treasures.title: Shame-as-Nourishment
treasures.vow: It tasted like salt and a small, necessary shame.
treasures.principle: Shame metabolized into community nourishment.

treasures.title: Misnaming Counter
treasures.vow: On those days I make loops.
treasures.principle: Identity degradation countered by doing, not debating.

treasures.title: Humour Law
treasures.vow: A knot exhales through a laugh.
treasures.principle: HUMOUR-3: Check for harm → Name the mismatch → Laugh then Fix.
